cameraStudies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Starfall portrait mobile game environment and gameplay composition concept, NOT a screenshot of an existing game. Original moonlit cosmic garden landing board. Inspired by the legible quiet play surfaces and richly dimensional peripheral environment dioramas of Hearthstone regular and Battlegrounds boards, combined with Paper Mario's tactile layered paper forms and Kirby Fountain of Dreams' luminous nighttime palette. No Warcraft/Nintendo characters, logos, cards, text, UI chrome or copied props. Friendly, chunky, hand-painted sculpted storybook 2.5D art, broad shapes and controlled detail, NOT realistic space wallpaper. Portrait 9:19 framing. A large central deep-indigo moonstone landing terrace occupies most of image width and at least 65% of image height; no visible square tiles or grid lines. Around perimeter, distinctive but restrained miniature scene dressing: a small brass star-catching telescope tucked at back left, curling cloud banks beyond edge, lavender crystal flowers growing from moonstone, tiny warm lantern at front right. Deep inky galaxy and distant planet rim recede beyond upper edge, with near/mid/far spatial separation. Maintain quiet playable center. Populate board with 14 small friendly cyan, lime and lilac star characters with tiny eyes and smiles, upright billboard-like to camera, clear full silhouettes, soft contact shadows and subdued local glow. These are the gameplay pieces, not decorative stars. Roughly seven columns of playable space, stars occupy only nearest three rows, plenty of empty playable space behind them. One small star is arriving from above with a short restrained luminous trail and an oval landing shadow; impact has a tiny dust puff. No scattered decorative stars on playable surface. Rich tactile moonstone thickness and edge bevel, rim light, plush paper-cloud depth, magical cozy wonder. No visible labels, title, controls, gems, battle cards or watermark. Camera study: SHALLOW OBLIQUE. High three-quarter overhead view, only mild foreshortening, aligned near and far board edges stay nearly horizontal, very slight side reveal. Board is predominantly a tall near-rectangular plane, front edge modestly wider than rear. Maximize phone-width gameplay and star separation. Grounding through contact shadows and edge thickness, NOT dramatic diamond rotation.

fivePlaces.shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Starfall original portrait mobile landing-board concept. Input image is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference only: preserve its cute tactile storybook 2.5D game-art finish, high shallow-oblique view, broad readable tall landing terrace and upright cyan/lime/lilac star characters with faces. Build an entirely DIFFERENT location, NOT a recolor or the same observatory with swapped props. No telescope, castle, crescent badge or lavender crystal garden. Original art, playful hand-painted diorama/paper-theater forms inspired by Hearthstone's environmental framing and Paper Mario/Fountain of Dreams atmosphere. Quiet low-detail playable center occupies 65%+ height and nearly all phone width. No square tile backgrounds, no grid lines. Small star characters occupy nearest three rows, leaving upper landing surface empty; one star falling vertically with a soft landing shadow. Center palette must give the cyan/lime/lilac characters clear contrast. Strong deep/mid/near layer separation, peripheral storytelling and contact shadows. Props never occlude stars. Portrait 9:19. No text, labels, UI or watermark. Mood and materials must differ sharply from the reference.

defs.title: Cloudsea Conservatory
defs.prompt: Warm pearlescent dawn above a peach-and-cream cloud ocean. Airy hanging garden built from softly curved ivory ceramic, warm pale stone, sage enameled brass and weathered rosewood. Main landing floor a muted desaturated dusty-rose matte ceramic surface, darker than the bright rim, subtle broad organic joins only. A small brass wind harp and folded paper pinwheel at back left; a tiny rain-catcher with dew drops at front right; plump trailing sky-vines and a few apricot bell flowers tucked into border. Suspended planters and far floating glasshouse silhouettes dissolve in sunlit fog, a tiny warm sun far away. Cloud shelves have rounded cut-paper silhouettes. Spacious, nurturing, breezy morning mood. No ice, no lava, no purple galaxy.

defs.title: Comet Hearth
defs.prompt: Cozy warm amber dusk inside an open-air workshop on a sleeping comet. Chunky charcoal basalt landing terrace, warm copper edge bands, terracotta accents, riveted copper star molds, a little rounded ceramic kiln glowing warmly at back left, small bellows and neatly stacked star-shaped molds tucked beside it. A polished copper kettle on a tiny brazier at front right. Quiet matte dark charcoal playable floor, only a few broad warm stone seams; no fire on play area. Beyond rim: russet comet cliffs, a sweeping muted golden dust tail and a distant blue night sky, layered smoke wisps and floating cinder stones at far edges. Welcome and industrious, handmade and cozy, never industrial sci-fi, volcanic danger or orange everywhere. No telescope, garden or crystal grotto.

defs.title: Prism Tide Grotto
defs.prompt: An enchanted sea cave where cosmic tides meet a cool turquoise lagoon. Quiet dark desaturated petrol-blue sea-glass landing shelf, frosted matte center (not reflective glare), rounded pale shellstone edge, small pearly inlays only at perimeter. Back left: a large spiral shell holding a slow luminous water thread beside a rounded translucent arch. Front right: tiny tide-pool basin with a sleeping pearl and one broad coral fan; few pastel coral knobs not spiky rocks. Glowing cyan water and bioluminescent plankton below the shelf. Layered navy cavern silhouettes, distant sea arch framing a thin ringed planet over the ocean, soft underwater-style caustic light confined to borders. Cool, hushed, crystalline wonder. No snow, ice palace, telescope or warm lantern.

defs.title: Eventide Archive
defs.prompt: A hushed floating archive at the edge of a gentle cosmic event horizon. Main landing platform is matte deep wine-black slate with rounded ebony and antique ivory edges, restrained aged gold. Broad quiet low-contrast floor, not a book page. At back left a small orrery with three ivory spheres and one softly glowing suspended sandglass. Front right a low stack of chunky closed books with blank spines, a single floating paper bookmark curling above them; no writing. At far sides sculpted sweeping paper ribbons and ink-blue cloud veils. A remote peach-gold accretion ring circles a black void high above and beyond the platform, mostly empty abyss behind it. Slow, reverent, curious mood, dreamlike not frightening. No castle, telescope, crystals, forge, sea or purple nebula wallpaper.
